title: Data Engineer
description:
DATA ENGINEER

£60,000
NOTTINGHAM

This is an exciting opportunity to join an established financial services organisation undergoing a major data transformation. You'll play a key role in developing a modern Microsoft Fabric data platform, building scalable data pipelines and helping shape the future of the organisation's data infrastructure.

THE COMPANY

Our client is an established financial services organisation with a strong heritage and a growing focus on technology and data transformation.

The business is investing heavily in modernising its data architecture, moving towards a centralised Microsoft Fabric platform to improve data accessibility, reporting and business intelligence.

This is an opportunity to join a growing data team at an early stage of its transformation, with the chance to influence technical decisions, introduce best practices and make a tangible impact.

THE ROLE

  • Develop and enhance a modern Microsoft Fabric data platform

  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and transformation processes

  • Develop Medallion Architecture across Bronze, Silver and Gold data layers

  • Integrate multiple data sources into a centralised Lakehouse environment

  • Work with Python, SQL and PySpark to deliver robust data engineering solutions

  • Support the development of a trusted, centralised data environment for analytics and reporting

  • Collaborate with engineering, governance and analytics teams to deliver data solutions

  • Drive improvements across automation, performance, scalability and engineering best practices

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Commercial experience working with Microsoft Fabric in a production environment

  • Strong Python development skills

  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines

  • Exposure to the Azure data ecosystem

  • Understanding of data architecture, data modelling and modern data platforms

  • Experience with PySpark, SQL and Lakehouse architectures would be advantageous

  • Knowledge of CI/CD and engineering best practices would be beneficial

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

SALARY AND BENEFITS

  • Up to 15% discretionary bonus

  • 29 days annual leave

  • Competitive pension contribution

  • Healthcare cover

  • Annual salary review

  • Hybrid working (2 days per week in the office)

HOW TO APPLY

Please register your interest by sending your CV through to Harry Lack via the 'Apply' link.
